messages.subject: searching co-mentor for gsoc18
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

  I am in a quest for a co-mentor, expert in R, for the following GSoC18 project proposal:

  https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2018/wiki/Sampling-and-volume-approximation

  Thank you in advance for your feedback.

Best,
Vissarion Fisikopoulos
